content.text:
Image ready.
Download URL (no auth needed, expires in ~5 min; re-run get_output for a fresh link): https://cloud.comfy.org/api/s/7QE77jSuTX62hfcsq3eEng?raw=1
Suggested save path: ~/Downloads/ComfyUI/comfy_output.png
Source: node 20, SaveImage, filename_prefix="KingdomIdle/Mage/Lightning_Pilot_Nano"
Run this command yourself now (via your own shell/tool) to save the file (keep the URL exactly as given — do not strip the ?raw=1 query parameter, or the download reverts to a redirect a sandbox may block), then tell the user the saved path — do NOT just print the command and ask the user to run it. Only hand the command to the user if you cannot execute it yourself (no shell, or a sandbox egress block returning 403 Host not in allowlist):
curl -L --fail-with-body --retry 3 --retry-all-errors --retry-delay 1 --connect-timeout 20 --speed-limit 1024 --speed-time 30 --create-dirs -o "$HOME/Downloads/ComfyUI/comfy_output.png.part" -- 'https://cloud.comfy.org/api/s/7QE77jSuTX62hfcsq3eEng?raw=1' || { rm -f "$HOME/Downloads/ComfyUI/comfy_output.png.part"; false; } && mv -f "$HOME/Downloads/ComfyUI/comfy_output.png.part" "$HOME/Downloads/ComfyUI/comfy_output.png"
